manual.note: OMOM42836U, listed as the 2012 RAV4 Owner's Manual on toyota.com/owners/warranty-owners-manuals/vehicle/rav4/2012/. Oil capacity p.488, viscosity p.489, tires p.494 (printed page = PDF page index + 1). Toyota lists a second 2012 RAV4 owner manual, OM42862U (https://assets.sipb.toyota.com/publications/en/om-s/OM42862U/pdf/OM42862U.pdf). Its oil table gives 4.6 qt (4.4 L) with filter for the 2.5 L engine instead of the 4.7 qt (4.4 L) shown here (OM42862U p.506); the V6 figures and the tire table (OM42862U p.512) are identical. Figures on this page follow OM42836U, the first manual listed for 2012.

oilCapacity.value: 2.5L 4-cylinder (2AR-FE): 4.7 qt (4.4 L) with filter, 4.2 qt (4.0 L) without; 3.5L V6 (2GR-FE): 6.4 qt (6.1 L) with filter, 6.0 qt (5.7 L) without
oilCapacity.unverifiedNote: Only the two engines listed in this manual are covered. Any other engine offered in this market: not yet verified.

oilViscosity.value: 2.5L 4-cylinder (2AR-FE): SAE 5W-20 or 0W-20 (0W-20 is the best choice for fuel economy and cold starting); 3.5L V6 (2GR-FE): SAE 5W-30 (SAE 10W-30 may be used, but replace it with 5W-30 at the next oil change)

recalls.summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain model year 2006-2012 RAV4 vehicles manufactured July 28, 2005, to December 19, 2012, and 2012-2014 RAV4 EV vehicles manufactured July 24, 2012, to August 29, 2014.  In the event of a frontal collision, the rear seat belts for the outboard seats may be cut by the seat cushion frame.

Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain model year 2009-2012 RAV4 vehicles manufactured October 27, 2008, to December 19, 2012 and 2012-2014 RAV4 EV vehicles manufactured July 24, 2012, to August 29, 2014.  In the affected vehicles, water may drip onto the joint that connects the wiper linkage to the wiper motor.
